newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks ease on Wall Street weakness.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks ease on Wall Street weakness.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks eased in thin London trade on Wednesday, reversing initial gains, as Wall Street fell, traders said.

By 1539 GMT, the Hang Seng London reference index was down 52.59 points at 13,640.20. Overnight Hong Kong's Hang Seng had closed down 40 points at 13,692.79 after a surge in prices led to profit taking.

"Most of the morning, the index was up 15 points on the back of the banks, which were up on the back of a firm FTSE, but selling pressure on recent good performers has pushed it down," one trader at a major house dealing in Hong Kong stocks said.
He said the market was now looking to IBM stock's reaction to analysts' earnings downgrades.
"They put pressure on Wall Street and that puts pressure on us," he said.
By 1539 GMT, HSBC Holdings shares were quoted at HK$179.45, ahead of their HK$178.50 overnight close. Hutchison Whampoa Ltd shares were traded at HK$62.675, down from their HK$64.25 close.
